name: Paimbnails
description: Thumbnails, capture, visual effects, audio, emotes, profiles, and custom backgrounds for Geometry Dash.

auto-update.name: Auto Update
auto-update.description: Download and apply updates automatically when the game closes.

level-search-enter.name: Quick Search Key
level-search-enter.description: Key to trigger search in the level browser.

realtime-search-preview.name: Realtime Search Preview
realtime-search-preview.description: Shows search results as you type.

discord-rpc-enabled.name: Enable Discord Rich Presence
discord-rpc-enabled.description: Show your activity on Discord. Configure details in Paimon Hub > Discord.

level-thumb-width.name: Thumbnail Size
level-thumb-width.description: Width of the thumbnail area in level cells.

compact-list-mode.name: Compact Mode
compact-list-mode.description: Shorter level cells to fit more on screen.

levelinfo-background-style.name: Background Style
levelinfo-background-style.description: Visual style of the level info background.

dynamic-song.name: Dynamic Song
dynamic-song.description: Play the level song at a random position when viewing level info.

profile-music-enabled.name: Enable Profile Music
profile-music-enabled.description: Play custom music when viewing profiles.

menuMusicEnable.name: Enable Menu Music Player
menuMusicEnable.description: Vinyl button in main menu for library, playlists and downloads.

editorMusicEnable.name: Enable Editor Music
editorMusicEnable.description: Listen to your music library inside the level editor on a separate audio channel. Toggle the mini player with the Editor Music keybind.

editorMusicToggleKeybind.name: Toggle Editor Music
editorMusicToggleKeybind.description: Show/hide the editor music mini player (only works inside the level editor).

menuLoopConstantShuffle.name: Menu Loop Shuffle
menuLoopConstantShuffle.description: Change menu loops automatically after each song finishes.

menuLoopEnableNotification.name: Now Playing Notifications
menuLoopEnableNotification.description: Show a toast when the menu loop song changes.

menuLoopNotificationTime.name: Notification Duration
menuLoopNotificationTime.description: How long the Now Playing toast stays on screen (seconds).

menuLoopCustomPrefix.name: Notification Prefix
menuLoopCustomPrefix.description: Text shown before the song name in the toast. Use [Empty] to hide.

menuLoopSeekAmountMs.name: Seek Step (ms)
menuLoopSeekAmountMs.description: Milliseconds the skip forward/backward buttons move.

menuLoopShowPlaybackProgress.name: Show Playback Progress
menuLoopShowPlaybackProgress.description: Show the seek bar and skip buttons inside the Menu Music popup.

menuLoopEnableKeyboardShortcuts.name: Menu Music Hotkeys
menuLoopEnableKeyboardShortcuts.description: YouTube/VLC/Spotify-like hotkeys inside the Menu Music popup (0-9 to seek, Ctrl+S to shuffle, etc.).

menuLoopSaveSongOnGameClose.name: Remember Last Menu Loop
menuLoopSaveSongOnGameClose.description: Resume the last menu loop when you reopen the game.

menuLoopRandomizeOnLevelExit.name: Randomize on Level Exit
menuLoopRandomizeOnLevelExit.description: Pick a new menu loop when you quit back from a level.

menuLoopRestoreOnLevelExit.name: Restore Position on Level Exit
menuLoopRestoreOnLevelExit.description: Resume the previous menu loop from where it was when you return from a level.

menuLoopRandomizeOnEditorExit.name: Randomize on Editor Exit
menuLoopRandomizeOnEditorExit.description: Pick a new menu loop when you quit from the editor.

menuLoopRestoreOnEditorExit.name: Restore Position on Editor Exit
menuLoopRestoreOnEditorExit.description: Resume the previous menu loop from where it was when you return from the editor.

colorful-icons-enabled.name: Paimon Icons (Recolor)
colorful-icons-enabled.description: Recolor every icon (icon kit, shops, achievements, rewards) using your player colors. Detailed settings - color modes, lock styles, animations, presets - are inside the garage gear button.

custom-slider-enabled.name: Custom Slider Thumb
custom-slider-enabled.description: Replace slider thumbs with your player icon.

dynamic-popup-enabled.name: Dynamic Popups
dynamic-popup-enabled.description: Custom entry/exit animations for Paimbnails popups.

dynamic-exit-enabled.name: Dynamic Popup Exit
dynamic-exit-enabled.description: Apply dynamic transition effects when closing Paimbnails popups.

popup-blur-enabled.name: Popup Blur
popup-blur-enabled.description: Blur the background behind Paimbnails popups.

custom-cursor-enable.name: Custom Cursor
custom-cursor-enable.description: Replace the OS cursor with a custom image.

enable-thumbnail-taking.name: Enable Capture Button
enable-thumbnail-taking.description: Show capture button in pause menu.

settings-panel-keybind.name: Open Settings Panel
settings-panel-keybind.description: Key to open/close the Paimon settings panel.

capture-keybind.name: Capture Thumbnail
capture-keybind.description: Key to capture a thumbnail during gameplay.

zoom-in-keybind.name: Zoom In
zoom-in-keybind.description: Zoom in while the game is paused.

zoom-out-keybind.name: Zoom Out
zoom-out-keybind.description: Zoom out while the game is paused.

zoom-reset-keybind.name: Reset Pause Zoom
zoom-reset-keybind.description: Reset zoom and show the pause menu.

zoom-toggle-menu-keybind.name: Toggle Pause Menu
zoom-toggle-menu-keybind.description: Hide or show the pause menu during pause zoom.

main-menu-layout-keybind.name: Layout Editor
main-menu-layout-keybind.description: Opens the button layout editor on the main menu and pause menu.

volume-scroll-title.name: Volume Scroll
volume-scroll-title.description: Modifier + scroll wheel to change volume in-game and in the editor.

volume-music-mod-game.name: Music Volume (Game)
volume-music-mod-game.description: Hold this key (or right-click / a configured mouse button) while scrolling to change the music volume during gameplay. Can be a single key (e.g. T), a modifier (Ctrl), or a combination (Ctrl+T).

volume-sfx-mod-game.name: SFX Volume (Game)
volume-sfx-mod-game.description: Hold this key while scrolling to change the SFX volume during gameplay.

volume-music-mod-editor.name: Music Volume (Editor)
volume-music-mod-editor.description: Hold this key while scrolling to change the music volume in the level editor.

volume-sfx-mod-editor.name: SFX Volume (Editor)
volume-sfx-mod-editor.description: Hold this key while scrolling to change the SFX volume in the level editor.

enable-disk-cache.name: Disk Cache
enable-disk-cache.description: Save thumbnails to disk to avoid re-downloading.

clear-cache-on-exit.name: Clear Cache on Exit
clear-cache-on-exit.description: Delete cached thumbnails when the game closes.

open-thumbnails-folder.name: Open Thumbnails Folder
open-thumbnails-folder.description: Open the folder where downloaded thumbnails are stored on disk.

texture-studio-enabled.name: Enable Texture Studio Button
texture-studio-enabled.description: Show the Texture Studio button in the main menu.

texture-studio-auto-apply.name: Auto-apply on Generate
texture-studio-auto-apply.description: Automatically copy generated packs to Texture Loader's packs folder.

enable-debug-logs.name: Debug Logs
enable-debug-logs.description: Show detailed mod logs in Geode console.
